messages:
hana (People Ops): quick check  Matt relocated from US -> UK mid-year and we did a payroll cutover soon after. He stopped 401(k) & HSA on move date. Can we send a retro employer match for the period he contributed and how does catch-up (50+) apply? Any vendor cutover gotchas?
leo (Payroll): dates pls  move effective, last US pay date, cutover. vendors differ but many accept manual remits with signed auth + payroll export within reconciliation window.
hana (People Ops): move effective 2025-05-12, last US pay 2025-05-23 (paid), payroll cutover 2025-06-15. Matt turned 50 on 2025-02-11.
leo (Payroll): ok. We can submit manual employer match for amounts actually withheld before move. Need: signed authorization PDF, payroll export showing elective & catch-up amounts, ssn_last4, legacy payroll id. If outside vendor window we request cutoff exception.
cara (Finance): From accounting: record expense when remitted and attach memo referencing eligible pay periods. Finance can fund once payroll confirms vendor acceptance (use GL 6700). Also loop legal for cross-border tax/reporting.
matt (Employee): I did elect catch-up earlier and had some withheld. Happy to sign. Does this mean I get the full annual catch-up limit?
leo (Payroll): You can only have catch-up remitted for amounts actually withheld on US payroll. Plan allows annual catch-up, but we can't fabricate withheld amounts.
policy-bot: Policy excerpt: "Employer match is calculated on elective deferrals actually remitted. Catch-up contributions follow IRS rules and the plan document. For manual remits during a cutover, contact payroll@redwood and use the manual remit template: https://docs.redwood.com/benefits/forms/manual-remit-template.xlsx"
hana (People Ops): Action items: I'll collect export (Jan->05/23), get Matt to sign the manual remit template, post ssn_last4 & payroll id via secure channel. Leo will open vendor ticket after docs are posted. Cara will pre-authorize funding estimate.
leo (Payroll): will open ticket (ref TKT-401K-REM-2114) once docs uploaded. If vendor asks for quarter cutoff exception i'll escalate.
hana (People Ops): thanks team :white_check_mark: will post signed PDF later today.
